text: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
Behold, as the eyes of servants lookunto the hand of their masters, andas the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes waitupon the LORDour God, until that he have mercy upon us.
Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, andwith the contempt of the proud.
